slice: Current-source ARM64 Kernel built-in driver import smoke

build.command: docker buildx build --progress plain --platform linux/arm64 --target kernel --build-arg KOKONUT_CLICKHOUSE=false --load --tag kokonut-kernel-current-arm64-driver-boundary:local --file Dockerfile.kernel .

runtime_smoke.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --entrypoint python3 kokonut-kernel-current-arm64-driver-boundary:local -u -c '<assert aarch64 and resolve all source-owned built-in targets through the adapter contract>'

limitations: QEMU software-emulation evidence only; no physical Raspberry Pi, power-loss, thermal, measured-resource, or storage-endurance acceptance.
The no-network, read-only smoke validates built-in import and adapter contracts only; it does not exercise authenticated requests or live providers.
